title.en: A possible world hidden in old starlight
title.zh: 旧星光里，藏着一个可能的新世界

summary.en: Rubin finds dwarf planet candidate 2026 ED138; brightness suggests size, while infrared follow-up is still needed.
summary.zh: 鲁宾发现矮行星候选天体2026 ED138；体积仍是亮度推算，尚待红外观测。

title.en: The chip supplier becomes an investor
title.zh: 当芯片供应商也成了投资者

summary.en: Nvidia plans a $3 billion Meta equity investment alongside an expanded AI partnership; financing and performance claims require care.
summary.zh: 英伟达拟投30亿美元参与Meta股权融资，并深化AI合作；融资到账与性能承诺须分清。
